channel.title: EU Funding News · Ullswater Investments
channel.description: Daily, verified news on European funding for innovators, researchers and SMEs: Horizon Europe, EIC, Digital Europe, defence, cohesion funds and Spanish R&D grants, with links to the official sources.

item.title: Ullswater launches its Funding Assistant, an AI chat for EU calls and Spanish grants
item.description: The free assistant, now on every Ullswater website, answers questions on 465 open and forthcoming EU calls, more than 150 Spanish State and regional grants, funding news and events, and links each answer to its source.

item.title: STEP report: almost €24 billion mobilised and 614 Seals awarded
item.description: The second annual STEP report shows €23.9 billion of EU funds mobilised by end-2025, €5.3 billion in direct calls last year and defence added as a fourth sector.

item.title: EIB Group approves €14 billion, a third for EU energy autonomy
item.description: The EIB and EIF Boards back €14 billion in new financing, with €4.2 billion for clean-energy infrastructure and €3.8 billion for business competitiveness.

item.title: EDF project D-STORM opens €90,000 cascade call for SMEs
item.description: The European Defence Fund project D-STORM offers up to €10,000 to SMEs and start-ups with operational know-how on loitering munitions and combat drones, until 11 January 2027.

item.title: Innovation Fund 2026: €5.2 billion in five calls opening 3 December
item.description: The Commission will launch three grant calls and two auctions under the Innovation Fund on 3 December, with online info days on 9, 10 and 15 December.

item.title: Horizon Europe opens €297 million digital calls with 12 topics
item.description: Two new Horizon Europe calls under the digital strand cover frontier AI, AI-driven robotics, energy-efficient AI data centres and virtual worlds, open until 18 March 2027.

item.title: EIC Fund survey: 64% say it was essential to close their round
item.description: A survey of 182 companies backed by the EIC Fund finds strong support for its role in fundraising, while asking for faster processes and more follow-on capacity.

item.title: AI Office seeks up to 100 European AI providers for SMEs via EDIHs
item.description: European AI providers with market-ready solutions can apply until 17 December 2026 to join an 'EDIH Ready' catalogue that Digital Innovation Hubs will offer to SMEs.

item.title: EIC Accelerator picks 35 deep tech firms for €84 million in grants
item.description: Out of 453 full applications, 35 start-ups and SMEs from 17 countries were selected; 32 of them will be assessed for EIC Fund equity of up to €10 million each.

item.title: EHDS webinar on 25 November: benefits of health data secondary use
item.description: The fourth webinar of the Commission's EHDS stakeholder support series discusses the benefits, challenges and incentives of reusing health data. Open to all.

item.title: EU launches first global alliance of climate and health funders
item.description: Launched at COP 31 with the Wellcome Trust, the initiative will align research funders' priorities. A secretariat starts work in January 2027.

item.title: ERC Synergy Grants 2026: €500 million for 48 research teams
item.description: The European Research Council selected 48 teams out of 957 proposals, a record number of applications, for frontier research projects worth €10.4 million on average.

item.title: CDTI opens €150 million INNTERCONECTA-STEP call on 17 November
item.description: Spain's regional R&D consortia call funds company-led projects in STEP technologies, with at least €10 million reserved for women's health.

item.title: Australia signs deal to join Horizon Europe's Pillar II
item.description: Australian organisations will be able to join and lead Pillar II consortia, with transitional access to calls from January 2027.

item.title: First EDIP Ukraine support call draws 58 defence proposals
item.description: The €184.5 million USI-IRA call on missiles, ammunition and bombs attracted bids from 11 Member States and Ukraine; results are due in March 2027.

item.title: MEPs back €200 billion Horizon Europe for 2028–2034
item.description: Parliament's industry and research committee wants €200 billion for the next research programme, above the Commission's €175 billion proposal.

item.title: Spain's Manza Energía tops first EU energy communities prize
item.description: Ten citizen-led energy communities from six countries share €1 million in the first EU Prize for Governance Innovations in Energy Communities.

item.title: EIC Pathfinder Challenges 2026 draws record 1,138 proposals
item.description: Submissions almost doubled on 2025 for an indicative €96 million budget across three challenges, with results expected in spring 2027.

item.title: EIT HEI Call 2026: up to €1.25M for university-led deep-tech consortia
item.description: The EIT Higher Education Initiative is funding HEI-led consortia that build deep-tech and manufacturing innovation capacity. Deadline: 13 January 2027.

item.title: EIB alliance channels over €10 billion into European scale-ups
item.description: Fifteen institutional investors and seven Member States join the EIB Group's European Tech Champions alliance, aiming to mobilise up to €80 billion.

item.title: EU and India conclude talks on India joining Horizon Europe
item.description: Association is envisaged for January 2027. Indian organisations would then be able to receive funding directly and lead Pillar II collaborative projects.

item.title: EIC 2027 work programme opens over €1.8 billion for deep tech
item.description: The Commission has adopted the EIC's 2027 plan: €578 million for the Accelerator, €248 million for Pathfinder and €100 million for a defence equity call.

item.title: EIC sets 19 November info day on its 2027 funding opportunities
item.description: The online session will present Work Programme 2027 scheme by scheme, from Pathfinder to STEP Defence. Registration closes on 18 November.

item.title: CDTI Innovación commits €12.75 million to 19 R&D+I projects
item.description: All 19 October approvals are loans. Ten companies get CDTI funding for the first time, 15 are SMEs and 13 operations are co-financed by POPE.

item.title: Open Research Europe becomes fee-free in 11 countries
item.description: Researchers in 11 countries can now publish on the Commission's open-access platform without publication fees, under a collective funding model.

item.title: EU and Bpifrance plan €150 million guarantee for Ukraine partnerships
item.description: The arrangement under the Ukraine Investment Framework targets French–Ukrainian industrial ties in defence and dual-use technology.

item.title: Commission proposes €31.7 billion for Ukraine's defence industry
item.description: The proposal covers 2027 under the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan. The Council still has to adopt it before disbursements start.

item.title: Canada joins EuroHPC as a Participating State
item.description: Agreed at the EU–Canada Summit in Montreal, the move opens Europe's public supercomputing, AI and quantum resources to Canada.

item.title: Horizon Europe opens 14 'Health' topics for 2027, due 17 February
item.description: HaDEA has published the 2027 'Health' calls, from antivirals and antimicrobials to AI biomarkers and point-of-care diagnostics. Info day on 26 November.

item.title: First EIC defence equity call closes with nine applications
item.description: The EIC STEP Scale Up Defence call offered direct equity of up to €30 million per company; results are expected in early 2027.

item.title: Guidelines on generative AI in research get their largest update
item.description: The ERA Living Guidelines for researchers, research organisations and funders were updated on the same day the first 13 EOSC nodes went live.

item.title: RAISE pledging initiative launched for AI in science
item.description: Companies and philanthropic organisations are invited to support researchers who use AI, mainly with models, computing capacity, software, data and training.

item.title: Horizon Europe Cluster 4 opens its 2027 calls
item.description: Industry, two-stage and RAISE calls opened on 13 October; the digital call on federated and sustainable AI data processing opens on 17 November.

item.title: New €230 million Horizon Europe call on nature
item.description: Ten topics to raise biodiversity spending across Pillar II of the 2026–2027 work programme, with most deadlines on 14 January 2027.
